verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a self-hostable gateway, but the evidence never mentions vendor telemetry, usage reporting, or any opt-out setting. The cited analytics, OTel metrics, and audit-log features are observability the operator collects about their own traffic, not vendor tracking the user can disable. The architecture note that the control plane stays out of the data path by default is about data-path visibility, not a telemetry opt-out.
